$comment: Inputs for tools/season_from_research.py: maps the 2006 entrants to pack teams, colours and tracks. Rules, engines and the Dunlop tyre come from the era base (bases/dtm-era3, set up on 2003); 2006 sets the A4 and C-Klasse car profiles, the 2006 weights and the knockout qualifying of the base. Each make ran 4 new, 4 one-year-old (2005) and 2 two-year-old (2004) cars: older cars weigh 15 kg less (1,035 kg; the 2004 cars' weight is not known, so they get the same) and get less development headroom (potential 3 and 2, wishlist C4 and D7). Team colours are first estimates, not yet checked against 2006 photos. Catalunya National and Le Mans Bugatti are traced into the era base (bases/dtm-era3/track_specs) with 2006's laps and tyre wear.
title: DTM 2006 - Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters

Vodafone/Salzgitter AMG-Mercedes.history: Run by HWA from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. Bernd Schneider won the title in 2000, 2001 and 2003.

DaimlerChrysler Bank AMG-Mercedes.history: The second HWA car pair. Gary Paffett won the 2005 title with the team. Mika Häkkinen is in his second DTM season.

Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline.history: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Runs the Audi works cars since 2004. Mattias Ekström won the 2004 title with the team.

Audi Sport Team Abt.history: The second Abt Sportsline car pair from Kempten. Tom Kristensen is in his third DTM season.

Stern/Easy Rent AMG-Mercedes.history: Ingmar Persson's team. Runs one-year-old 2005 C-Klasse cars. Jean Alesi races his last DTM season here.

Audi Sport Team Phoenix.history: Ernst Moser's team from Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Raced Opels until 2005. Runs one-year-old 2005 Audi A4s.

TV-Spielfilm/TrekStor AMG-Mercedes.history: Peter Mücke's team from Berlin. Runs one-year-old 2005 C-Klasse cars.

AutoScout24/Junge Gebrauchte AMG-Mercede.history: Two rookies on two-year-old 2004 C-Klasse cars. Car #21 is run by Persson, car #22 by Mücke.

Audi Sport Team Rosberg.history: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. Raced Mercedes until 2004. Returns with one-year-old 2005 Audi A4s.

Futurecom TME.history: Colin Kolles' team from Greding. New in 2006. Runs two-year-old 2004 Audi A4s.

track_overrides.$comment: 2006 race laps (research/calendar.csv, mostly derived from distance and lap length). tyre_wear_mult is the base's 2012 value scaled by 2012 laps / 2006 laps, so two stops stay the normal strategy. Not yet simulated.
